_meta.notice: General public-health information, not medical advice.

risks.title: Dengue Fever
risks.desc: More common during and after the monsoon. Symptoms can include high fever, severe headache, joint pain and rash. Seek medical care if you suspect dengue, and avoid self-medicating with anti-inflammatory painkillers unless a doctor advises.

risks.title: Cholera / Water-Borne Illness
risks.desc: More likely after flooding or with unsafe water. Drink only filtered or boiled water. Watery diarrhoea and dehydration need prompt medical attention; oral rehydration solution helps while you seek care.

risks.title: Heat Stroke
risks.desc: A risk in peak summer. Stay hydrated and avoid direct sun in the hottest hours. If someone is confused or unconscious in the heat, call 112 immediately.

risks.title: Air Pollution / Respiratory Issues
risks.desc: Air quality can be poor in urban areas. People with asthma should keep their prescribed inhaler with them and follow their doctor's advice on poor-air days.
